notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there, awesome gang:

Hope you are having a great one, shifting your way out of Neo Barcelona in one piece! A hell of a task to accomplish these days, we know. But rest assured, Jack has some tricks up her sleeve…
And we have some improvements and fixes to make things just a little easier in these streets.

Let's get down to business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/f461d52396b5ed25d82a056a4b66df3640a190e8.gif[/img]

[h2]⬆️ Updates:[/h2]

Increased the speed of the Quantum Blade!!
Reduced the size of the mini-map to improve screen visibility

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed Issue where game could get stuck on loading screen.
[*] Fixed issue where the Pulverator's Boss death sound effect would trigger every time Jack entered the boss room.
[*] Fixed issue where the timed door in Spaceport would reset upon Jack dying after completion.
[*] Fixed issue where VERA would get stuck in place upon a new activation when going back to Jack in while hacking something.
[*] Fixed Issue where you get a black screen when rescuing Harry after switching language.
[*] Fixed Issue where the game might skip some inputs during fast parkour.
[*] Fixed issue where some item pop-up would not appear.
[*] 1x1 Spikes now do damage as intended.

[*] Fixed visual issue where some enemy bullets would appear incorrectly on-screen during the intro cutscene.
[*] Fixed visual issue where the camera wouldn't follow VERA inside the Esperanza.
[*] Fixed visual issue where the crucible room in Spaceport would show as a long vertical room on the map.
[*] Fixed Visual Issue where UI disappears during Romance Dialogues.
[*] Fixed visual issue where the tutorial for the Quantum Shift in the Simulation would show incorrect button prompts.
[*] Fixed flicker on the Mod screen.

[*] Fixed Scroll functionality on the Data Tab.
[*] Fixed prompt where Health Cores where describes ad Health upgrades on the RoboDoc.
[*] Fixed Multiple Text formatting issues.
[/list]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119940/Altered_Alma_Demo/?curator_clanid=4777282"][/dynamiclink]

For all questions you may have, we encourage you to join our Discord and follow our social media for more updates!


See you in our next entry,
– 2Awesome Studio

notes.content:
[p]Hey there, awesome gang!![/p][p][/p][p]Summer is here!!—So is the heat, [b]remember to stay hydrated![/b] Can you believe we’re already halfway through the year? Time’s flying faster than Jack dashing going for some Burritos![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been hard at work on Altered Alma, and we’re excited to share what’s new. So let’s dive right in!
 [/p][h1]Development Progress 🛠️[/h1][p][/p][h3]⚔️ Jack’s Combat Evolution[/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/K2U4jT1.gif"][/img][/p][p]The [b]stomp attack[/b] isn’t just for breaking weak floors anymore. It’s a legit combat tool! Use it to damage and scatter enemies when they swarm you. Pro tip: the higher the fall, the bigger the boom.
[/p][h3]🚫 Barriers? Not a Problem[/h3][h2]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/SzaR7Ce.gif"][/img][/h2][p][i]Barriers are made to stop you and keep you away… Or that’s the idea. [/i][/p][p]Because the Quantum Blade know no limit. Shift through the energy barriers to reach new levels, you can take advantage of its solidity to hold on them and its quantic weakness to go through them when you need to.[/p][p][/p][h1]🔥 New Environmental Hazards & Enemies[/h1][h3][b]💀 Toxic Bubbles[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/Uo7kc6n.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Like a hot knife through butter—wait.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]There’s really no place safe down here, these toxic bubbles seem weak at first sight, but pack a punch, make sure you avoid them, or you’ll end in a puddle of your own tears, or in this case, all the waste of the city recollected.
[/p][h3][b]💢 Spiked Crushers[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/HqiF7JW.gif"][/img]
Introducing the [b]giant spiked crushers[/b], going under Spaceport doesn’t mean that will be an easy path… Lots of mechanical parts moving might become a death trap if you aren’t careful enough. Be aware of your surroundings and think fast, or you will become a tortilla in a split of a second. And beware of those who are also hiding, they don’t like to share their spot.
[/p][h3][b]🐀 Undercity’s Wildlife?[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/874IugC.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Seems like VERA made a new friend, a very twisted and mutated one. [/i][/p][p]Undercity is plagued by multiple radioactive wildlife, they may look cute… but you’re still in Neo Barcelona, not every friend-shaped is a friend.
[/p][h2]🍺Join us in the Undercity![/h2][p]Welcome one and all to Neo Barcelona’s biggest and shameless bar zone, take a seat! This rat infested—neon drenched—slimy grounded zone will teach you the very definition of scrapping the bottom of the barrel. Here you will find every person that had their troubles up there in the city, so be aware and don’t be surprised if they dislike the idea of moving up in the world.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/vteRYia.gif"][/img][/p][p]Long story short, the place is run by The Harlequins, a motley crew of assorted humans and aliens, just your average gang of gangs, who in hell taught these guys the true meaning of organized crime…? [/p][p]A district almost forgotten by the people of Neo Barcelona, some might say you’re wasting your time going down here, there’s simply nothing of value to be gained, and too much to lose.[/p][p]

notes.content:
Hey there, awesome gang:
We hope spring is treating you well—with sunshine, good vibes, and maybe a picnic or two! Can you believe we’re almost halfway through the year? Time’s flying faster than Jack dashing through Neo Barcelona!
We’ve been hard at work on Altered Alma, and we’re excited to share what’s new. So let’s dive right in!

[h2]Málaga was great!![/h2]
[i]Looking back at GuadalIndie 2025?![/i]
Mission accomplished! GuadalIndie 2025 was an unforgettable experience. Meeting so many of you in person, sharing the floor with other amazing indie games, and feeling the love from the community—it was all simply incredible. 💜 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/8c35b12d033712ecdd876bd25a84b052026e84cd.jpg[/img]
A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by our booth, shared kind words, or just came to say hi. Your support truly means the world to us.
Thanks so much for all your love and support—it means the world to us seeing you at events, cheering us on, and being part of this journey. 💜 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/464e09afecc8cd3868b465a9d3b71fbcb850ad8e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Development Progress[/h2]
[h3]🧪 Welcome back to Parc Güell…[/h3]
Get ready to explore one of the most striking areas in Altered Alma—[b]Parc Güell.[/b] Inspired by [b]Antoni Gaudí’s[/b] iconic real-world park, this biome offers a vibrant burst of lush greenery and surreal, organic architecture. Twisting pathways, hidden secrets, and dreamlike structures create a striking contrast to Neo Barcelona’s usual cyberpunk sprawl.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jWAnGZBNsu6gIwmVbn/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Parc Güell is home to the Shallari[/b], a fiercely orthodox community who have rejected the neon-soaked ways of the outside world. Centered around their communal egg nest, the Shallari live with one single purpose: to protect the purity and survival of their kind—at any cost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/0eb2dfd0238030234617e0c146affe36d1ee3e2a.png[/img]
Brutal, dogmatic, and deadly, many Shallari can recite [b]twenty-six different ways to kill a person[/b], but might not know how to make a sandwich. They shun cybernetics, considering both augmentation and exile equally impure. Those who leave Parc Güell often embrace the very tech their kin despise, becoming a divisive presence among the Shallari diaspora.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/7e5f51409220a131b22097bc5aa64b538b4468a7.png[/img]
[h3]🧑‍🚀 Waiting for you![/h3]
Red Rosie, the best armorer of Neo Barcelona gets bored a little easy, if she’s not fighting, you may find her making, tweaking or upgrading the weaponry system on the ship. Will you say hi to Rosie?
[i]Here is a quick shot of our favorite Psycho armorer. ❤️[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/57c49ce8a21cf13550acfe36f4d311f992e41b72.gif[/img]
[h2]Dev Update: May Progress[/h2]
[list]
	[*]We improved the Spaceport area, updating the visuals and level design.
	[*]New enemies and environmental hazards have been implemented.
	[*]Some bosses have been spotted fighting Jack on the city.
	[*]Parc Güell has been improved, updating the visuals and level design.
	[*]Las Ramblas has been improved, updating the visuals and level design.
[/list]

A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.
And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!

notes.title: File #13 // April Update + GualdalIndie
notes.content:
Hey there, awesome gang:
We hope spring is treating you well—with sunshine, good vibes, and maybe a picnic or two! Can you believe we’re almost halfway through the year? Time’s flying faster than Jack dashing through Neo Barcelona!

We’ve been hard at work on Altered Alma, and we’re excited to share what’s new. So let’s dive right in!

[h2]Sun, Beach and Indies!![/h2]
[i]We’re heading to Malaga![/i]
Yup, it’s time to soak up the sun and indie game goodness at [url=https://guadalindie.com/]GuadalIndie 2025![/url]

Thanks so much for all your love and support—it means the world to us seeing you at events, cheering us on, and being part of this journey. 💜 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/d57dcc820ab519cdc6a9d1a4f169a9c4154f1c86.jpg[/img]

📍 We’ll be at the [b]Palacio de Ferias y Congresos de Málaga[/b]
📅 [b]May 16–17[/b]

If you’re near Málaga, come say hi! We’d love to meet you and show you the latest from Altered Alma.

[h1]Development Progress[/h1]
[h2]🧪 New Dangers Below…[/h2]
The deeper you dive into Neo Barcelona, the weirder—and more dangerous—it gets. You might want to watch your step…

Say hello ([i]or maybe don’t[/i]) to the mutants of Clavageres, a twisted underground zone crawling with freakish enemies, lurking shadows, and... acidic surprises. 😱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/0c198cbd1d7e89d1466be72090335dbfd3be99e7.gif[/img]

This area is home to Harlequins, mutants, and all sorts of enemies that definitely aren't pet material. You’ll need to be fast, sharp, and always on your toes—because down here, Jack won’t get a single second to breathe.

[h2]🧑‍🚀 Meet the Crew![/h2]
It's not all doom and gloom, though—Jack’s never truly alone. In our next teaser, you’ll get a glimpse of a happy moment of the Esperanza crew: the whole crew together, chatting and… hmmm… it seems that they are scolding their dear captain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/7cd83813c612fd009ee0a8b45f84e4af705cf33d.gif[/img]

[h2]💥Alert! Danger incoming - VFX Upgrade[/h2]
Danger has a new face. When enemies gear up for a devastating heavy attack, Jack defense systems will now send a warning sign through the chaos. It’s your split-second chance to dodge, counter and show them who’s the boss.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ymNJE5r.gif[/img]

But that’s not all — we’ve cranked up the action with fresh VFX that turn every battle into a spectacle. When Jack strikes, you’ll feel it: Enemies will explode in brutal blood splatters that paint the battlefield, each cut will now paint the wall with the true amount of damage you make with your blade.

[h1]Dev Update: April Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*] We improved the Spaceport area, updating the visuals and level design.
[*] New enemies and environmental hazards have been implemented.
[*] We’ve implemented new VFX for enemies, and reworked some old VFX too.
[*] The team has also improved a little more in the dagger movement and game feel.
[/list]

A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.
And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!

notes.title: File #12 // March Update
notes.content:
Hey there, awesome gang:
Hope you're all kicking off the year in high spirits! The journey from the year's start till now has been a whirlwind for us. Thanks for all your support this kickstart of the year, we’re working hard on Altered Alma to improve and expand this amazing adventure in Neo Barcelona!
We have a few announcements to make, so let's get started!!

[h2]Back From GDC!!🎶[/h2]
[i]And not Empty Handed![/i]
GDC 2025 was an unforgettable experience for us at 2Awesome Studio! We kicked things off with [b][u][url=https://www.dayofthedevs.com/" rel="noopener noreferrer]Day of the Devs[/url][/u][/b], where we had the incredible opportunity to showcase [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190700/Altered_Alma/" rel="noopener noreferrer]Altered Alma[/url][/u][/b] alongside some of the most exciting indie games out there. Seeing players experience our game firsthand and getting direct feedback from the community was truly inspiring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/4f14226da7003e3a6656084ac4956896fed42122.jpg[/img]

Our journey at GDC didn’t stop there. We took part in the [b]Meet to Match pitching session[/b], sharing our vision for [b]Altered Alma[/b] and exploring exciting new opportunities. It was amazing to see so much interest in what we’re building!
We were also honored to be featured at the [b][u][url=https://europeangameshowcase.com/" rel="noopener noreferrer]European Game Showcase[/url][/u][/b], a fantastic event that allowed us to present [b]Altered Alma[/b] to an international audience of publishers, investors, and industry professionals. Networking with other talented European developers and getting exposure on such a global stage was an invaluable experience.
And here’s the big news—we were not only nominated for a [b]Best in Play Award[/b], but we actually [b]won[/b] one! Being recognized at [b][u][url=https://gdconf.com/gdc-play-gdc-pitch" rel="noopener noreferrer]GDC’s Best in Play[/url][/u][/b] was an absolute highlight for us, and it means so much to see the passion and hard work we’ve put into [b]Altered Alma[/b] being celebrated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/7a27a9b3ad3c56e4d13fc1728ecc3dd02af521fd.jpg[/img]

[h2]More Home Events[/h2]
We are also happy to announce that we will attend to another Spanish event/festival, this time in [u][url=https://toledomatsuri.com/videojuego/altered-alma/" rel="noopener noreferrer]Toledo Matsuri 2025[/url][/u], located in the [b]Recinto Polideportivo de Salto de Caballo[/b], an event full of Video games, Board games, E-Sports, anime and many more.
You can find us at the [b]Indie Zone[/b] along with other amazing Indie games and studios, we will wait for you there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/c3c686be0b9e3cd0de8016a381b085753fe16ac9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Development Progress[/h1]
We’ve been hard at work refining [b]Altered Alma[/b], and we’re excited to share some big improvements! Our [b]movement system[/b] has been upgraded, making parkour and combat feel smoother and more dynamic than ever. Now, you’ll have [b]more flexibility to chain parkour moves seamlessly while fighting[/b], even when facing multiple enemies at once.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HYNmXH3.gif[/img]

But that’s not all—we’ve also expanded the combat system with [b]better combos and new attacks[/b], giving you even more ways to take down enemies in style. Whether you prefer quick, agile strikes or powerful, devastating hits, the new mechanics will let you fight on your terms.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/N6OReyV.gif[/img]

And here’s another exciting update—our spaceship companion, [b]Bailey[/b], they are getting animated! 🎨⚙️ Our beloved engineer will soon be joining the [b]Esperanza[/b] crew, bringing even more life and personality to your journey. 
We can’t wait for you to meet them in action!
[h2]Hill of God[/h2]
In the world of [b]Altered Alma[/b], the legendary [b]Hill of God[/b]—inspired by the real [b]Montjuic [/b]in Barcelona—stands tall as the headquarters of [b]The Crusaders[/b], the city's elite [b]law enforcers and mercenaries[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/36365db5ca52ca125bf17cbc12a41f8c8eaa888f.png[/img]

Perched above [b]Neo Barcelona[/b], this towering stronghold is both a [b]symbol of order and a fortress of power[/b]. The Crusaders rule from here, enforcing their own version of justice, whether the city agrees with it or not. Expect [b]intimidating architecture, high-tech security, and an air of authority[/b] that makes it clear—this is not a place you enter lightly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/895a8358a8a9230bc5231841a7623f82f4948006.png[/img]

But in a city like [b]Neo Barcelona[/b], power is never absolute, and even the mightiest fortresses have their cracks. What secrets lie within the [b]Hill of God[/b]? That’s for you to find out… if you dare.

[h2]Upgrades and Updates[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NjRoAEu.gif[/img]

In a city like [b]Neo Barcelona[/b], where the skyline glows with endless neon, our [b]visual effects need to match the energy of the night[/b]. That’s why we’ve given a fresh update to [b]most projectiles[/b], making sure every shot, blast, and impact looks [b]as stunning as the city itself[/b]. One of our favorites? [b]“The Malware”[/b]— If you're gonna fight in the neon-lit streets, might as well do it in style, right?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vK7G6Wb.gif[/img]

If you thought you could just run and hide—think again. 
[b]The Chaser[/b] is here to make sure that once you're spotted, there's no easy escape. These relentless hunters will [b]lock onto you the moment they detect your presence[/b] and won’t stop until they’ve either [b]torn you apart or lost sight of you[/b]. 
Now, with a [b]sleeker, sharper, and more agile design[/b], they’re [b]faster, deadlier, and more precise[/b] than ever. Every move is calculated, every attack is ruthless—leaving you even less room for mistakes. [b]Are you ready to survive?[/b]
[h1]Dev Update: March Progress[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Improved combat mechanics and new move-set
	[*]New bosses and enemies added to the game
	[*]Improved aerial movement for better parkour and combat
	[*]New VFX and reworked old VFX
[/list]
A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.
And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!

notes.title: File #11 // February Update + GDC
notes.content:
Hey there, awesome gang:

Hope you're all kicking off the year in high spirits! The journey from the year's start till now has been a whirlwind for us. Thanks for all your support this kickstart of the year, we’re working hard on Altered Alma to improve and expand this amazing adventure in Neo Barcelona!

[i]We have a few announcements to make, so let's get started!![/i]

[h2]🌉If you’re going to San Francisco!!🎶[/h2]
[i]Be sure to look for Altered Alma at GDC![/i]
We’re super excited to be there! We’re also not showing up empty-handed – we’ve got a [b]DEMO on site[/b]. That’s right!! From [b]March 17th to the 21st[/b], join us if you happen to be there as we hit the streets of Neo-Barcelona and let us know what you think… So come by and say hi!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/5683a7596f27806f3d582b8e70a9d66282e47a5b.png[/img]
The event will take place in [b]San Francisco, California, at the Moscone Convention Center[/b] ([b][i]Catalan Pavilion, Booth: S969[/i][/b]) we are excited to see you there and hear you about what you think about Altered Alma, we will be waiting for you.
We made lots of changes and improvements from the feedback we received from past events and Q&A Sessions. Your words are never lost in the wind, and we take them into account for future updates.

[i]Speaking of improvements:[/i]

[h2]⚙️Development Progress[/h2]
[h3]🗡️Jack’s Combat Evolution[/h3]
Jack’s moveset just got even deadlier! We’ve added some new tricks to his arsenal, making fights feel more fluid, powerful, and satisfying.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/juwY2BN.gif[/img]
Sometimes, a quick jab just won’t cut it. Jack can now charge up a massive strike to break through enemy defenses and deal some serious damage. The trade-off? Charging leaves you wide open, so make sure to time it right—one wrong move, and you might be the one getting wrecked instead!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RKbLbZt.gif[/img]
Got enemies hiding below, thinking they’re safe? Think again. Jack can now rocket downward with a brutal [b]Stomp attack[/b], crushing anything ([i]or anyone[/i]) unlucky enough to be underneath. Just be careful where you land—some floors might not hold up, and you could find yourself dropping into a whole new mess!

[h3]🌆 New Environmental Hazards & Enemies[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/H9HLvVx.gif[/img]

[b]Fire Traps:[/b] These bad boys light up the battlefield—literally. 
Once triggered, they blast out waves of fire, turning entire areas into blazing hot zones. You’ve got two choices: run fast or roast.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RFzVHst.gif[/img]
“[i]If not friend, Why Friend-Shaped?[/i]” —Jack
Meet the [b]Hellhound[/b], a massive, bone-crushing beast that’s programmed to hunt you down relentlessly. It’s fast, aggressive, and very bitey.
 
[h2]📅 Dev Update: February Progress[/h2]
[list]
	[*][b]Parc Güell[/b] Area is now complete and ready to explore.
	[*]Art assets for [b]Gothic and Born[/b] area are nearing completion.
	[*][b]HUD:[/b] is being completely reworked, now under testing.
	[*]We also improved [b]Jack's character controller[/b] in order to have a more precise movement control over the character.
	[*]The [b]AI for several enemies[/b] has been adjusted.
	[*]New [b]enemies animations[/b] and executions have been added.
	[*]New [b]NPC’s animations[/b] have been added.
	[*][b]Kickstarter roles [/b]have been given.
[/list]
A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.
And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!


And that’s all for now, guys! Stay tuned for updates! And that’s all for now! For all questions you may have, we encourage you to join our next [url=https://discord.com/invite/zbHkqt9Gth" rel="noopener noreferrer]Q&A session on Discord[/url] — the date is still to be determined, but our public form is now open to everyone.

notes.title: File #10 // 🎁 Happy Holidays + 2024 Recap 🎁
notes.content:
Hey awesome gang!!


As we wrap up an unforgettable 2024, the entire Altered Alma team wants to wish you a [b]Happy Holidays and an awesome new Year![/b] This year has been one of the most exciting in our studio’s history, and it’s all thanks to you—our amazing community.
Your support has been the driving force behind every milestone we’ve achieved, and we are endlessly grateful for every pledge, comment, and a bit of enthusiasm you’ve shared with us. So, let’s take a moment to celebrate what we’ve accomplished together in 2024!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/89ca94ccd67598cde036db7644cb827f62f678cd.png[/img]

[h1]🌟 2024: A Year Full of Milestones[/h1]

It’s been a whirlwind year for Altered Alma, and we’ve loved every second of sharing the journey with you. Let’s look back at some of the highlights:

[h3][b]🌍 Nordic Game[/b][/h3]
Taking Altered Alma to one of Europe’s biggest industry events was an incredible experience. Meeting fans, developers, and showcasing Neo Barcelona to a global audience was unforgettable. 
One special highlight was meeting [b]Amelia Jones [/b][i](Singer of Hollow Knight, Slay the Princess, Alan Wake 2 and many more)[/i], who also played Altered Alma during the event, and now we have the honor to have her as a [b]Guest Singer for our soundtrack[/b].
Thank you, everybody who visited our booth at Malmö, Sweden.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/c472c6bd9c1cebb1e592001530edc258948abce4.jpg[/img]
[i]Amelia Jones playing Altered Alma during the Nordic Game 2024[/i]

[h3][b]🎮 Gamescom[/b][/h3]
In August, we travelled to Cologne, Germany to showcase Altered Alma on the Indie Arena Booth, and we unveiled Altered Alma with our Kickstarter announcement and Demo Trailer ([i][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190700/Altered_Alma/"]That you can still play[/url][/u][/i]). It was thrilling to finally share the game with the world, and the response blew us away, thank you for sharing that excitement with us.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/4d079bebf7a99f0e1d384bb0bd55de25a6dda729.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]✈️ G-Fusion in China[/b][/h3]
Taking Altered Alma internationally and introducing it to players at G-Fusion was an amazing opportunity to connect with even more passionate fans of indie games. We didn’t expect such a great reaction, and we really appreciate it, as you have no idea.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/afed6ff823dac9d257defc79e65b95556819ad70.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🏙️ Indie Dev Day in Barcelona[/b][/h3]
Our hometown event was especially close to our hearts. Sharing the game with our local community in Neo Barcelona’s real-life counterpart was a surreal and emotional highlight. We took our signed banner home to remember all of you that came to visit and tried the demo live with us and share your thoughts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/9c81ee9667bd96f19e0f1fc2aad27101830f4e9c.jpg[/img]

These events reminded us how universal the love for storytelling and games truly is. Whether we met you at one of these events or online, every interaction has fueled our determination to make Altered Alma a masterpiece.

[h1]💥 Kickstarter Recap![/h1]
Our [i]Altered Alma[/i] Kickstarter journey was nothing short of phenomenal. We started with a goal of €40,000, and thanks to you, we surpassed that number in 6 hours like it was nothing (even if the Kickstarted website gave up for a little while with all of you coming at the same time). 
And then we reached over [b]€260,000[/b]! On Kickstarter and Backetkit all together!! You will never stop to amaze us, you are awesome!
The overwhelming support allowed us to unlock exciting [b]community and stretch goals[/b]—like having the amazing Amelia Jones to be part of our soundtrack with her talented performance, English voice acting, spaceship decoration, our beloved pet system on the Esperanza and many-many more…
Thank you for believing in our vision and helping us make it a reality. Every pledge has brought us one step closer to building the cyberpunk Metroidvania of our dreams!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/e3cb49cd077c9412a53391364b1a01ebc6813245.jpg[/img]

[h1]🏙️ A Closer Look at Neo Barcelona’s New Biomes[/h1]
As development continues, we’ve been pouring our passion into creating the stunning, unique environments of Neo Barcelona. Here’s what’s on the horizon:
[h3][b]🌳 Parc Güell Biome[/b][/h3]
Inspired by the iconic park designed by [b]Antoni Gaudí[/b], this biome features lush greenery interwoven with surreal architecture. Organic shapes and mysterious pathways invite exploration, offering a contrast to the urban cyberpunk aesthetic.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GcLVxwY.gif[/img]
[i]Hunt or be hunted on this wild gardens where only the strong will survive[/i]

[h3][b]🌊 Barceloneta Biome[/b][/h3]
The city’s shoreline is reimagined as a bustling, cyberpunk-infused district. Amid the neon lights reflecting on the waves, you’ll find vibrant life, hidden secrets, and danger lurking in the depths.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/uJsGO2t1tNJSvewOdD/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Visit landmarks like Port Vell, Hotel Vela, Rambla del Mar and many more iconic places…[/i]

[h3][b]🏰 Gothic & Born Biomes[/b][/h3]
This biome dives into the rich history of Barcelona, transforming the city’s Gothic and neighboring “[i]El Born[/i]” Quarter into a dark and atmospheric maze. Expect eerie architecture, ancient secrets, and challenges that test both your skills and wits.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HRhVYqf.gif[/img]
[i]Explore Barcelona’s Cathedral, Basílica del Mar and try not to fall off the Kiss Mural[/i]

Each biome is being crafted to feel alive, with intricate details and gameplay opportunities that reflect Neo Barcelona’s essence. We’re incredibly excited to show you even more as development progresses!


[h1]✨ Looking Ahead to 2025[/h1]
With such a strong foundation laid in 2024, we’re diving into 2025 with renewed energy and focus. Here’s what you can look forward to:
[list]
	[*]🕹️ More development updates and sneak peeks into gameplay.
	[*]🌟 New surprises, including additional features we’re keeping under wraps for now.
	[*]📅 Progress updates as we march closer to completing [i]Altered Alma[/i].
[/list]
The journey is far from over, and we’re so grateful to have you with us every step of the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/4430f0f701fc7d6ebe296e9298dbe5e95fe22f0e.png[/img]

From all of us at [b]2Awesome Studio[/b], thank you for being part of [i]Altered Alma[/i]’s journey. We wish you a joyful holiday season, and an incredible New Year filled with adventure, joy, and lots of gaming!

Here’s to an exciting 2025! 🥂

notes.content:

Hope you're all kicking off the year in high spirits! The journey from the year's start till now has been a whirlwind for us. [url=http://tinyurl.com/AlmaSteam5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/bd3b760ff0cdb8112b0467866a117c91fbdbd3b3.png[/img][/url]

We also hope all of you also had an amazing and rocking year so far. We have more updates and exciting news for you. Let’s get started!!

[b]We are heading to Malmö, baby!![/b]

We’re super excited to assist the [b]Nordic Game 2024[/b], and guess what? We’re not showing up empty-handed – [b]we’ve got a playable DEMO in tow[/b]. That’s right!! [b]From May 21st to the 24th[/b], join us if you happen to be there as we hit the streets of Neo-Barcelona and let us know what you think.

[url=https://nordicgame.com/developer-showcase/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/41f3b1b3156aecdddd3175ac9e614eb9bbc8378e.png[/img][/url]

The event will take place in [b]Malmö, Sweden[/b] at the [b]Slagthuset complex[/b] ([i][u]Booth DSS-25[/u][/i]), we are excited to see you there and hear you about what you think about Altered Alma, we will be waiting for you. 

We made lots of changes and improvements from the feedback we received from past events and Q&A Sessions. Your words are never lost in the wind, and we take them into account for future updates.

[b]Speaking of improvements:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VQiEsPa.gif[/img]

[b]Jack’s new hacking skills[/b] brought new combos and attack options to the table, and now they include [b]Status effects.[/b] You have many ways to attack and defend yourself in the dangerous alleys of Neo Barcelona, and while we don’t want to spoil future surprises, we can tell you that status effects will be a part of the special attacks and skills we’ll reveal in the future.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qb8sNSr.gif[/img]

Jack’s bombs don’t only deal explosive damage – now they can leave a lasting [b]Pyro status[/b] effect on the environment and nearby enemies that burns and damages enemies that come in contact with the flames. 

And if grenades are not an option because of the close distance? Wear a temporary flaming shield that protects Jack and burns enemies that get a little too close. Warm and cozy.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oD7GCIM.gif[/img]

You can also use attacks with a [b]Cryo status[/b] to freeze enemies in place; whether it’s a cryo bomb or a freezing [b]360-degree explosion[/b] around Jack, they will give you some chill time to plan your next movement.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CMGSbet.gif[/img]

And sometimes you don't have to keep your feet on the ground, climbing and jumping are great options for getting around, this way you'll have a better ability to explore all the corners of the city and have the High Ground against your opponents.Walls are not only to stop bullets, they are also a great way of moving around.

[h3]Dev Update: May Progress[/h3]
A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been hanging on the last events and our Discord Q&A sessions. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy during these events, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.

And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!

[*] [b]The Ramblas Area[/b] is now complete and ready to explore.
[*] [b]The Romance System[/b] is now running. Make the right choices and you may have a partner for the next Valentine’s day.
[*] We also polished Jack's character controller in order to have a more precise movement control over the character.
[*] [b]The Killshifts[/b], those sweet executions Jackelyne can perform are now easier to make, and easier to enjoy.
[*] Implemented new animations for enemies, NPC's and combat
[/list]

And that’s all for now, guys! Stay tuned for updates! And that’s all for now! For all questions you may have, we encourage you to join our next [url=https://discord.com/invite/zbHkqt9Gth]Q&A session on Discord[/url] — the date is still to be determined, but our public form is now open to everyone.

notes.title: File #05 // Meet the gangs of Neo-Barcelona
notes.content:
Good morning, gang!

[b]WE WILL BE ON KICKSTARTER[/b]

Are you interested in contributing to the growth of Altered Alma and maximizing its potential as a project? You can!

[url=http://tinyurl.com/AlmaSteam5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/bd3b760ff0cdb8112b0467866a117c91fbdbd3b3.png[/img][/url]

In the upcoming year, we are starting a Kickstarter campaign to propel Altered Alma to new heights, and our pre-launch campaign page is [url=http://tinyurl.com/AlmaSteam5]now live[/url]. 

With this campaign, our aim is to broaden the game's horizons, introduce more features, and sculpt a Neo-Barcelona experience that lingers in players' memories! Plus, brace yourself for spectacular rewards, both in digital and physical forms, of course!

Be sure to click the follow button on the [url=http://tinyurl.com/AlmaSteam5]Kickstarter page[/url] to stay updated and not miss the launch next year. It helps a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/676690eeebad50cb48ace579546009bcf656f445.jpg[/img]

Now it’s time for another [b]monthly dev log[/b] — this time we’re starting a series of devlogs, covering the most notorious criminals of Altered Alma.

Being the city of opportunities, Neo-Barcelona attracts all sorts of individuals. And since there are not enough legal opportunities for everyone, some decide to take matters into their own hands — turning to organized crime.

[i]Crusaders, Harlequins, Shallari, La Familia[/i] and [i]Vynefolk[/i] — these are the names you should remember when visiting Neo-Barcelona. It’s them who actually control the city, manipulating the officials from the shadows. 

After years of bloody gang wars, each group now controls their own part of the city. And while most of them try to uphold the “official” truce, some never accept the terms and always look to stab others in the back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/a7f405f26b1da16eb14f6eccc6936387c569f25c.jpg[/img]

Today we’ll talk about the [b]Crusaders[/b] — the self-proclaimed modern knights. Their ranks consist of [b]highly disciplined cyborgs[/b], who value honor (even if it’s street honor), order and tradition. Yes, despite being cyborgs, they don’t just blindly worship chrome and steel, but also try to preserve the centuries of rich culture found in Neo-Barcelona.

Under the leadership of [b]Megaduke Synthetico[/b], they primarily engage in mercenary activities. Given the considerable cost of hiring mercenaries, the Crusaders find themselves undertaking assignments exclusively for affluent clients or those who have amassed sufficient resources to enlist their services.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/9b0f29f21786f37c832c84f7d966b97434b07762.jpg[/img]

Working for the rich also helps forge relationships with the most influential people of Neo-Barcelona. And In a city where power and influence mean everything, you’d be a fool to miss such an opportunity. This, combined with the Crusaders’ cyber-enhanced strength and good subordination, makes them one of the most respected gangs in the city. Which is why Jackelyne once was a member of this organization.

Would you give up a part of your humanity to become a modern knight? Hop on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/YHpe5SPeMQ]Discord server [/url]and let us know your choice! 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/YHpe5SPeMQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/5e11844cc2fede2df446da84d01b3abda894c640.png[/img][/url]

[h3]DEVELOPMENT UPDATE: NOVEMBER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Metro area is now complete
[*] Designed new bosses and mini bosses rooms
[*] Worked on new mission cutscenes
[*] Made a lot of improvements in the platform perspective, props and decorations for a better playing experience
[*] Implemented new animations for enemies, NPC's and combat
[*] Improvements on the UI
[/list]

This past month has also been pivotal in refining the overarching narrative and design, with new concepts and ideas being brought to the table and meticulously documented.

And that's all for today!

Have a great day,

notes.title: File #04 // Neo-Barcelona now and then
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/3c23430ca51954fb9f4ce8ed59a8c70565264ec4.jpg[/img]

Welcome back, dear gang!

Not long ago, we came across one of these popular timelapse videos that show the look of a place over the years. It made us think about [b]Neo-Barcelona[/b], and [b]how much it has changed since its first appearance in Aeon Drive[/b]. Of course, we refer to both the artistic and game design vision. As we have evolved over the years as developers, so has the world in which Jackelyne's story unfolds — plus, it's important to remark that they’re [b]not the same city[/b], so each version has its peculiarities.

Leaving this detail aside, there are many interesting aspects to talk about. The first and most important is the role of the city in each adventure, as it has become a protagonist of the series in its own right. 

While in Aeon Drive the city was a mere witness to the adventures of Jack, who had crashed there escaping from an interstellar war, in Altered Alma Neo-Barcelona is at the center of the action. Therefore, this time the player will walk through a world full of light and life, but also darkness and death. The same streets that saw our protagonist grow up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/c96d23dcf1cdea3c1744226c59df2b4fe5416b15.jpg[/img]

This is due to the main concepts that guided the development of each game. Aeon Drive was born as a game made for fast gameplay and speedrunning. It means that players should see the most important elements of the game in the forefront to optimize their actions at every moment, so the background loses importance to dimension engine cores, enemies and obstacles. Here, Neo-Barcelona is a mere crossing point.

In contrast, the Neo-Barcelona we introduce in Altered Alma is designed to encourage and reward immersion — not just in terms of map exploration, but also by looking closely at the elements composing each room. 

The more you explore and scratch, and the more attention you pay to the scenes, the closer you will get to the very essence of this city. For example, you'll soon notice [b]how deeply rooted gang culture is[/b] in the history and politics of Neo-Barcelona, and what kind of relationship their leaders have. This knowledge is [b]intertwined with the main plot[/b] of the game and, sometimes, the [b]player’s choices will have a meaningful impact[/b] on this power balance. Everything contributes to making the city feel like a living organism that never stops changing.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OihDTV3.gif[/img]


Altered Alma's artistic style was born by mixing two very opposite ideas: the coldness of life in a cyberpunk environment and the need to preserve elements of the past, using them as a base to create something new, refined and expressive. The locations where this combination is most evident are those we have taken from the real Barcelona.

We refer to famous landmarks like the Sagrada Familia, a cathedral that inspired an entire biome in the game. But there’s more to it — from buildings and sculptures to small props like street signs and vending machines, there are many others related to catalan culture scattered all over the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/cabcbbe25a20a4dff7adcd418454d520d495897c.png[/img]


Another aspect we cared a lot about was the artistic expression of light and shadow in the new Neo-Barcelona. It's important to understand that there's a close relationship between cyberpunk societies and nightlife. Neo-Barcelona awakens as the sun goes down, so it's during nighttime that the best and the worst of this city show up. When you build up light on top of darkness as we do, it's easier to make the brighter elements stick out. Poetic, isn't it?

Besides this, it's very important for level design as we cannot take visibility away from the platforms in favor of aesthetics. A poor approach in this regard can kill the player’s desire to see what lies beyond.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/enjmAGR.gif[/img]


As mentioned before, you need to explore new areas in order to progress in the story of Altered Alma. You can revisit them as many times as you want, and sometimes there will be new events waiting for you. Some of them will be part of the main story, while others will be side quests. These secondary missions will also help you learn more about Neo-Barcelonian gangs, make new friends and, even, develop unexpected romances with Jack's crew members.

Each district brings new chances to get rare resources, meet key citizens and uncover the dirty secrets of those in power. Of course, there’s a certain risk in going so far… No gang will allow you to dive into their territories without permission. In fact, you might end up fighting some particularly strong enemies. But that shouldn’t be a problem for an experienced mercenary!

Speaking of the fat cats, there's one more new thing worth mentioning related to Altered Alma's Neo-Barcelona. As shown in our latest trailer, some bosses will use environmental attacks on Jackelyne. By this integration of the background into action, we aim to create spatial awareness and add more mechanics to the fight via inanimate objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/a6795de7aa38bff77ee4a0ab477dc9b0beb94052.png[/img]


Last but not least, here’s some stuff that our lead artist [url=https://www.artstation.com/sirelion]Sergio Cabanillas[/url] used as reference:
[*] [i]Metrópolis[/i] (1927, Fritz Lang), film — German expressionism.
[*] Paul Verhoeven, movie director— Sarcasm and cruelty as narrative elements.
[*] [i]Brave New World[/i] (1932, Aldous Huxley), novel — Dystopian societies, dark humor.
[*] [i]1984[/i] (1949, George Orwell), novel — Dystopian societies.

We hope you’re up to visit Neo-Barcelona when Altered Alma is out. There's no better way to appreciate all the hard work behind its stunning visuals than giving it a chance.

With all this said, let’s move to our monthly dev update!

Heyo, dear gang:

We hope you survived the post-holiday blues and had a wonderful month. For us, September has been quite intense! Within a few weeks of each other, we attended two new events and faced the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479140/AKxolotl/]another game[/url], whose extense promotion campaign made us a bit exhausted. So here we are, squeezing our last energies to bring you a new update. Let's get started!

[h2]EVENTS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/974010ac2e43ce4f0427835e85428e78e1af8ba3.jpg[/img]

In preparation for Indie Dev Day and the Tokyo Games Show, we read and analyzed all the feeback we gathered at Gamescom. As a result, we could improve the alpha demo for the new players and everyone noticed the slight changes our team introduced. We're confident that the notes we took at these events as the visitors played will be plenty useful to rethink some concepts and polish the final game.

We were pleasantly surprised by the comments mentioning how responsive Jackelyne feels, the smoothness of platforming and the beauty of the game art. Plus, players really liked the energy dagger both as a weapon and transportation method.

notes.title: File 01 // What to expect from this metroidvania adventure
notes.content:
Morning, gang!

It’s been a month since Altered Alma was featured in the PC Gaming Show and we opened the doors of this tiny blogging space. Though it might seem a little time, the truth is that a lot of interesting stuff happened over all these weeks. The most important one is that [b]the number of wishlists[/b] you gave us [b]exceeded our wildest estimations[/b]. This is the action that helps us gain more relevance on Steam, so we feel super grateful that so many people believed in the game. Thank you very much! <3

Having said the good news, it’s time to move on and offer you a few more details on Altered Alma's key features. This is, basically, what you’ll be able to do in the game as Jackelyne, our charismatic and deadly antiheroine.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/VwzQrrv.gif[/img]

[h3]A space opera metroidvania[/h3]
Set in the futuristic metropolis of Neo-Barcelona, Altered Alma follows the rise of a young but talented mercenary named Jackelyne. This expedition will take you both to the brightest and the darkest areas of the city, where you'll find your first jobs as well as a colorful cast of multicultural rivals to prove your strength, potential crew members and interesting stuff that may help you restore your spaceship. 

Once a location has been unlocked, you'll be free to pay a visit as many times as you want — the deeper you go into its alleyways, the bigger your reward will be… but also, the risks to take. Usually, you'll end up pissing off the big bosses of the Neo-Barcelonian underworld, so make sure to be ready for that moment!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/PMT4NxA.gif[/img]

[h3]Revisit Barcelona like never before[/h3]
Despite the game’s dystopian undertone, we'd love players to wish they could get lost in the city. Altered Alma is a love letter to the real Barcelona, where 2Awesome Studio is based in, and its colorful society. We mixed our memories and feelings with some crazy ideas of what we think this place could be like in a very distant future. The result is a dreamy neon-lit metropolis fed on dreams and ambition, with all kinds of dark secrets lying under the surface.

As you may have noticed in Altered Alma’s first trailer, the game will feature iconic landmarks such as the Sagrada Familia, Park Güell and Las Ramblas. Wanna try and guess which other locations we haven't shown yet?


[img]https://i.imgur.com/RzkPFtB.gif[/img]

[h3]Engage in intense combat[/h3]
What fun would it be to seize power without smashing a couple heads first? That's not the way of a mercenary, you know. In Altered Alma, violence will be your main tool for dialogue, because there is no language more universal and effective than a punch in the face. Or a stab, or a hammer blow… 

Master Jackelyne’s swift moves (jumps, feints, weapon throws) as you flow through the streets of Neo-Barcelona and adapt your combat strategy to each type of enemy you encounter. Plus, you’ll have the chance to enhance your body and learn a cool set of skills to slaughter your enemies in no time.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/YtM3Vz5.gif[/img]

[h3]Build up your headquarters[/h3]
Jack’s new spaceship is, with all the letters, a rust bucket on the verge of disintegration. But that’s about to change, because this girl is gonna do her best to give it a second life as the best headquarters ever seen in Neo-Barcelona! 

Explore the city in search of useful components to restore the transport and fill it with all kinds of useful resources — from a Repair Station, going through a workbench to create new power ups, to an Armory room. The crew members you hire after completing a plot event or a substory, as well as the quality of these relationships, also affect Jack's combat options and playstyle.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/vhehWP7.gif[/img]

[h3]Enemies to lovers[/h3]
Even in this unforgiving world, you will be able to find some affection. Spend time with your crewmates, listen to their woes and help each other on their journey. Maybe one of those relationships will reward you with true love!

Recently, we were asked in the Steam forums if Jackelyne will be able to like someone of the same gender. One more time, we want to make clear the answer is “yes”, all options will be welcome :)


[img]https://i.imgur.com/C29IhsO.gif[/img]

[h3]An all-star writing team[/h3]
It’s not everyday that you get legendary game writers Antony Johnston (Resident Evil: Village, Dead Space) and Emma Beeby (Tails of Iron, F1 2023) to create the story of your next game — this time, it happened to us. The story of Alma will make you gawp, we're 100% sure!




[h2]MONTHLY PROGRESS REPORT[/h2]
[list]
These are the aspects of Altered Alma we’ve been working on in the past few weeks:
[*] After a final review process, we can proudly announce that [b]the main story of the game is finally complete[/b] in its first draft form. Some character and gang names have changed A LOT, and we hope to be able to tell you more about it very soon.
[*] The [b]Metro district gang boss[/b] has been successfully implemented. We can’t wait for you to find out about it on social media!
[*] [b]New minor enemies[/b] just landed on the neon-lit streets of Neo-Barcelona. Rest assured that Jackelyne will give them a warm welcome ;P
[*] We implemented several [b]adjustments in other boss fights and city areas[/b].
[*] There’s a [b]new lighting system working for the whole map[/b] that intensifies the shadows and makes the streets look a bit darker, so you always feel a bit unsure of what might be lurking in the shadows…
[/list]


If you have any further questions, feel free to reach out to us in the comments section or through our community server on Discord. We’ll be happy to answer!

See you very soon,
2Awesome Studio & Critical Reflex
